notes.title: Glaze Cup:Journey to the West Version Update
notes.content:
Version Update

Dear Generals of the Curtain: 
Thank you for staying with us! We sincerely apologize for the delay since the last game update. As the development team behind "Glaze Cup:Journey to the West ", we remain committed to ensuring the game reaches its full potential. As a Roguelike action game blending ink-wash artistry with modern design, it offers a visually captivating experience. The journey of the Curtain General—challenging formidable foes, collecting fragments of the Glaze Cup, and uncovering the prequel secrets of Journey to the West—has ignited the adventurous spirit of many players.
However, we fully acknowledge the game's current shortcomings in controls and optimization, which may have impacted your experience, and we deeply regret this. We should have invested more time in refining the game before release. Now, we are fully dedicated to optimization efforts, striving to gradually improve the game's quality through updates and earn the favor of our players.

【 Version Update Notes】

 Added a game opening description, which will play when the game is launched for the first time, introducing the core background setting and player objectives.
 
 Added controller and keyboard/mouse operation instructions at the start of the game, optimizing the new player guidance experience.
 
 Added combat and exploration content to the tutorial level.
 
 Added highlighting for enemy attack projectiles.
 
 Added special effect feedback when enemy skills hit the player.
 
 Added mana consumption settings for the Cloud-Walking skill mechanism.
 
 Added description of mana consumption for the Flash Burst skill, and reduced its mana cost.
 
 Added cooldown time for the Pagoda skill, preventing summoning before the previous one expires.
 
 Fixed the issue where the game would freeze due to enemies not respawning after quest triggering.
 
 Fixed the map error in specific levels where players could get stuck between dual air walls.
 
 Fixed the issue where human soldiers in certain scenes would erroneously attack the player.
 
 Fixed the issue of the Exorcism Celestial Lord's weapon flying indefinitely.
 
 Optimized the "New Game" interface settings, not showing the "Erase Character Memory" description when first entering the game, only displaying this prompt during second operations.
 
 Optimized the balance of certain chapters, adjusting enemy values and combat rhythm.
 
 Optimized the opening animation, added a skip button, and fixed the black screen issue during the final dialogue.
 
 Optimized button prompts for controller and keyboard/mouse.
 
 Optimized the skill introduction window interaction, adjusting the triggering mechanism when switching to view different skills.
 
 Optimized level navigation guidance, adding arrow indicators in areas where direction misjudgment could easily occur.


More surprises await you in the game, Generals!

notes.title: 关于游戏发布日期的公告
notes.content:
Dear players

I apologize for not being able to release the game on time on January 5th due to insufficient estimation of the game's optimization content and time, as well as my own poor health and illness. I contacted the official Steam team in advance to make the changes, but due to the upcoming online exposure, I cannot make the changes before January 5th. I can only wait until this time before making the release date changes. We apologize again for disappointing everyone's expectations for the upcoming release of the game!

Current progress of the game: The issues that were previously reported in testing are currently being optimized or have been completed:

1. The controller support has been added, and the accompanying guidance and compatibility are also gradually improving

2. The game's numerical values are being modified and adjusted as a whole

3. The difficulty and numerical adjustments have also been made to some tasks with unreasonable feedback designs

4. Various explanatory prompts are gradually being added

5. The mechanisms of some bosses and monsters are also being modified

In addition, the game has also added some new content

1. Added more divine weapon equipment

2. Added more skill actions

In order to provide a better gaming experience for everyone, more tests will be conducted after the above optimization is completed to ensure the gaming experience. We will make every effort to ensure the quality of the game and hope that everyone can give me a little more time. Thank you all for your patience and understanding. Your support is very important for both the game and myself.
